## Goal check

<!-- Run `pnpm ready --pr-title "<title>" --pr-body <file>` and answer its questions here, one real answer per line. -->

**Goal:** <!-- Which `pnpm brief` number does this move, or which bottleneck in the marketing loop does it remove? How will we see it? -->

**Smallest change:** <!-- Is this the smallest change that gets that effect? What did you deliberately leave out? -->

**Fits the codebase:** <!-- Which existing modules and patterns did you reuse? Any second way of doing something, single-caller abstraction or new dependency? -->

**Verification:** <!-- What did you run and what did it show (tests, a real CLI run against the database, `pnpm db:audit`)? Paste the evidence, not a claim. If anything visual changed (web/ pages, components, styles), embed before/after screenshots. -->

**Risk:** <!-- Ad-account writes, write-guard changes or deleting/altering stored data need the owner's yes before merging; quote it. Otherwise "None". -->

**Privacy:** <!-- Read the whole diff, commit messages, title and description. Anything specific to a product, client or campaign removed? Say what you checked. -->

**Lessons:** <!-- Did the owner correct you? Which test, check or CLAUDE.md line now prevents it? Otherwise "None". -->
